title: MACA: A Framework for Distilling Trustworthy LLMs into Efficient Retrievers
authors: Satya Swaroop Gudipudi; Sahil Girhepuje; Ponnurangam Kumaraguru; Kristine Ma
why_relevant: Proposes distilling a metadata-aware LLM re-ranker into a compact retriever for enterprise FAQ search, with light teacher trustworthiness checks via permutation/paraphrase consistency.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on efficient retrieval distillation, not on RAG robustness to noise, conflict, adversaries, or generator calibration. Trustworthiness audit is incidental.
